text:
The schedule from my earlier answer holds. I re-checked every constraint against it and all 16 are satisfied.

The constraints name only eight people, so the ninth (slot 6) has no constraints. I called them "Eve" before. The team note calls them "Elif", so I've used that here. Which name goes in slot 6 doesn't affect any constraint.

The note's claims that Dev is in slot 3 and Ivo is in slot 2 match what I derived.

Derivation:
1. Cara is before Hana and Ben is right after Cara, so Ben is before Hana. Gus is right after Hana, and Ben and Gus must be at least 3 apart, so Ben is at least 2 slots before Hana.
2. Ann, Dev and Cara are all before Ben, so Ben is in slot 4 or later and Hana is in slot 6 or later.
3. Finn is after Hana with exactly one person between them, so Finn is Hana+2. Gus is Hana+1, so Hana is at most 7.
4. Hana in slot 6 forces Ben to 4, Cara to 3 and Ann to 1. Dev would then need slot 3, which Cara holds, so this fails. Hana is therefore 7, Gus is 8 and Finn is 9.
5. Ben in slot 4 fails for the same reason, so Ben is 5 and Cara is 4.
6. Ann is at least 3 before Ben, so Ann is in slot 1 or 2. Ann in slot 2 would put Dev in slot 4, which Cara holds. So Ann is 1 and Dev is 3.
7. Ivo must be before Gus and at least 3 away from Hana, Gus, Ben and Finn. Only slot 2 works.
8. The remaining person takes slot 6.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Ivo","3":"Dev","4":"Cara","5":"Ben","6":"Elif","7":"Hana","8":"Gus","9":"Finn"}
CONFIDENCE: 93
